entries.title: Acts 6:1
segments: ¶Now in those days, when [the number of] the disciples was multiplying, there arose a complaint against the Hebrews by the Hellenists, because their widows were neglected in the daily distribution.

entries.title: Acts 6:2
segments: Then the twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, "It is not desirable that we should leave the word of God and serve tables.

entries.title: Acts 6:3
segments: "Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of [good] reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business;

entries.title: Acts 6:4
segments: "but we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word."

entries.title: Acts 6:5
segments: And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch,

entries.title: Acts 6:6
segments: whom they set before the apostles; and when they had prayed, they laid hands on them.

entries.title: Acts 6:7
segments: Then the word of God spread, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were obedient to the faith.

entries.title: Acts 6:8
segments: ¶And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.

entries.title: Acts 6:9
segments: Then there arose some from what is called the Synagogue of the Freedmen (Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia), disputing with Stephen.

entries.title: Acts 6:10
segments: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

entries.title: Acts 6:11
segments: Then they secretly induced men to say, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."

entries.title: Acts 6:12
segments: And they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes; and they came upon [him], seized him, and brought [him] to the council.

entries.title: Acts 6:13
segments: They also set up false witnesses who said, "This man does not cease to speak blasphemous words against this holy place and the law;

entries.title: Acts 6:14
segments: "for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs which Moses delivered to us."

entries.title: Acts 6:15
segments: And all who sat in the council, looking steadfastly at him, saw his face as the face of an angel.
